assumption_boundary: The index type is finite and has decidable equality.
K, lambda, h, and q are real-valued.
Every h(i) is nonzero for the Doob quotient.
The stated left-eigenvector equation is assumed for stationarity.
The survivor normalization is assumed nonzero for normalized stationarity.
The stated right-eigenvector equation is assumed for zero row sums.
The geometric real log-exp bridge assumes q(i) > 0 and piStar(i) > 0.
The paper-native multiplicative real bridge at beta=1 needs no positivity assumption.
The paper-native pointwise log-exp theorem assumes h(i) > 0.

bridge_alignment.previous_ambiguity: The earlier powerBridge name described geometric interpolation between q and piStar, not the paper-native q_i h_i^beta normalized bridge.

non_claims: Does not prove empirical H-band universality.
Does not validate H-Tilt as scheduler.
Only proves finite algebraic survivor-law identities under stated assumptions.
The paper-native multiplicative bridge is now separated from the geometric q-to-piStar interpolation bridge.
